 Light \& Wonder is a global leader in game experiences. We create content, hardware and systems that connect iconic titles across any place or channel. By turning games into expansive entertainment, we keep thrilling players with characters and stories they can’t get enough of.
   

  

 Light \& Wonder, Inc. is the leading cross\-platform global games company.  Our Values
   

  

* Dare to be bold: We combine diverse talent to look at the familiar in unfamiliar ways.

* Uphold integrity: We promote accountability and respect to raise the bar for ourselves and the industry.

**Senior Associate Software Engineer\- Java Backend**
* Job Location: Commerzone IT Tech Park, Yerwada \- Pune.
* Required Experience: 1\-3 years
* Employment Type: Full\-time


**Job Description:**
 We are looking for a Senior Associate Back\-End Software Engineer to join our team at Light \& Wonder. In this role, you will help develop and maintain our backend game engines, contributing to the creation of top\-quality online slot games. You will collaborate closely with game designers, mathematicians, and frontend developers to deliver engaging and innovative gaming experiences.
   

  

 As part of our development team, you will implement the rules and mechanics of our online slot games. Familiarity with Java or another object\-oriented programming language is highly recommended, along with the ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code. This position offers opportunities to expand your skills in game development and general programming, working on exciting projects that will challenge you and support your career growth.

 As a Senior Associate Software Engineer your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Developing and maintaining game engines for Light \& Wonder digital games
* Writing comprehensive tests to ensure quality and reliability
* Creating technical and process documentation to share knowledge and best practices with the team
* Collaborating with game designers and mathematicians to implement game mechanics and features
* Working with frontend developers to ensure seamless integration of game engines with game clients
* Assisting the Quality Assurance team in testing and debugging games
* Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to other developers
* Contributing to the development of tools and processes to improve the efficiency of the game development pipeline
* Actively participating in team meetings and supporting the overall success of the team


**Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Java or another object\-oriented programming language, with a strong understanding of OOP principles
* Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
* Good knowledge of design patterns and their appropriate use
* Familiarity with structured file formats such as XML and JSON
* Ability to use debugging tools and analyse logs
* Practical experience with Version Control Systems (VCS), such as Git
* Understanding of Agile software development methodologies and tools like Jira
* Familiarity with SSH and command\-line tools
* Knowledge of SQL databases and SQL queries


**Nice to Have**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
* Understanding of online casino games and common game mechanics
* Experience with Java build tools such as Maven and its ecosystem
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python
* Experience with frontend technologies such as HTML, JavaScript, and browser debugging tools
* Understanding of CI/CD processes and tools
* Familiarity with mathematical and statistical concepts
* Experience with Excel and basic spreadsheet functions
* Passion for programming and state\-of\-the\-art technology

 Software Engineer II

* Exhibit teamwork aligned completely with the Agile environment


**All About You**
* Passionate about technology, with strong Object\-Oriented Programming Skills
* Good knowledge of product development
* Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot. Experience working on Event Driven Architecture would be an added advantage.
* Experience in Online / Real Time Systems development
* Experience in CI and CD. Experience in Cloud based development is desirable
* Strong Communicator
* Quick grasping and learning abilities

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Fullstack Java With React-Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Artificial Intelligence \& Engineering
   

  

 AI \& Engineering leverages  cutting\-edge  engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and  operate  integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission\-critical operations.
   

  

 Join our AI \& Engineering team to help transform technology platforms,  driving  innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements.  You’ll  work alongside talented  professionals  reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 Level: Software Engineer II
   

  

 As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high\-quality engineering solutions that support enterprise applications and client transformation initiatives. In this role, you will contribute across backend and front\-end development, apply modern engineering practices, and help deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. You will also support continuous improvement through automation, innovation, and strong execution within project timelines.
   

  

 Work you'll do
   

  

 As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …
   

  

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing React applications using TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and integration with RESTful or GraphQL services
* Evaluating solution options, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, scalable, and maintainable design decisions
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
* Supporting process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes


 The T eam
   

  

 Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering\-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
   

  

 Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* Core JAVA \& Backend engineering :
* 4\-7 years of strong hands\-on experience in JAVA( 8 \+) with solid grounding in Object\-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
* Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade\-offs
* Spring \& Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high\-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter\-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
* Experience implementing security and cloud\-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
* Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS \& SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* React
* 4 \- 7 years of hands\-on experience in React :
* Strong hands\-on experience building scalable and production\-grade React applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Strong understanding of React fundamentals, including JSX, component lifecycle, hooks, rendering behaviour , and component composition
* Experience implementing state management and data\-fetching patterns, using Context API and modern state libraries ( e.g. , Redux Toolkit/ Zustand / Recoil ) based on application complexity.
* Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross\-browser compatibility
* Hands\-on experience integrating React applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract\-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including route protection, secure token handling , and role\-based UI behavior.
* Strong testing and debugging skills with unit/component testing (Jest, React Testing Library) and end\-to\-end testing (Cypress/Playwright), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with React performance optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, memoization strategies, and efficient rendering of large data sets
* Familiarity with React build tooling, including modern bundlers (Webpack/Vite), environment configuration, and deployment optimization.
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership\-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high\-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery\-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains


 \#AIE2027
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Introduction**
 India Systems Development Lab (ISDL)
   

  

 IBM Systems division builds Servers, Storage and Systems Software which are the building blocks for next\-generation IT infrastructure of enterprise customers and data centers. IBM Servers provide best\-in\-class reliability, scalability, performance, and end\-to\-end security to handle mission\-critical workloads and provide seamless extension to hybrid multicloud environments.

ISDL teams work across the IBM Systems stack including Processor development, Firmware, Operating Systems, Systems Software, Storage Software, Cloud Software, Performance Engineering, System Test etc. The ISDL teams also ushered in new development models such as Agile, Design Thinking and DevOps.
   

  

****Your Role And Responsibilities****
 As a Software Engineer at IBM India Systems Development Lab (IBM ISDL), you will get an opportunity to work on all the phases of product development (Design/Development, Test and Support) across core Systems technologies including Operating Systems, Firmware, Systems Software, Storage Software \& Cloud Software.
   

  

**As a Software Developer At ISDL:**
* You will be focused on development of IBM Systems products interfacing with development \& product management teams and end users, cutting across Geos.
* You would analyze product requirements, determine the best course of design, implement/code the solution and test across the entire product development life cycle. One could also work on Validation and Support of IBM Systems products.
* You get to work with a vibrant, culture driven and technically accomplished teams working to create world\-class products and deployment environments, delivering an industry leading user experience for our customers

Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought was possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the most challenging problems in Systems Software technologies? If so, let's talk.
   

  

 Regular Job opportunities across ISDL teams are in the following areas.
   

  

 Systems and Cloud Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM Systems and Cloud Software teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in all the phases of software development and work with technically accomplished teams. The responsibilities comprise of design new enhancements, coding (including test automation), problem determination and bug fixing, performance analysis, and solving client problems. You could also work on IBM Compute and Storage Systems including Virtualisation, I/O and Reliability Availability \& Serviceability thereby, enabling the creation of a seamless software user experience across the stack delivering to IBM's Hybrid Cloud and AI clients. As an engineer you will be responsible for enhancing and maintaining the key components of the Software stack, Platform enablement and an opportunity to work on closed and Open source development communities.

You will be working as a Full stack developer starting from understanding client challenges to providing solutions using AI.
   

  

**IBM Spectrum Fusion SW Engineer:**
 IBM Spectrum Fusion container\-native storage solution for OpenShift is designed for enterprise customers who need global hybrid cloud data access. As a Software Engineer with IBM Storage Spectrum Fusion team, you will work with the Dev/Test team to develop and support features for Spectrum Fusion product roadmap.
   

  

**Linux Developer:**
 As a Linux developer, you would be involved in design and development of advanced features in the Linux OS for the next generation server platforms from IBM by collaboration with the Linux community. You collaborate with teams across the hardware, firmware, and upstream Linux kernel community to deliver these capabilities.
   

  

**Hardware Management Console (HMC) / Novalink Software Developer:**
 As a Software Developer in HMC / Novalink team, you will work on design, development, and test of the Management Console for IBM Power Servers. You will be involved in user centric Graphical User Interface development and Backend for server and virtualization management solution development in Agile environment.
   

  

**AIX Developer:**
 AIX is a proprietary Unix operating system which runs on IBM Power Servers. It's a secure, scalable, and robust open standards\-based UNIX operating system which is designed to meet the needs of Enterprises class infrastructure. As an AIX developer, you would be involved in development, test or support of AIX OS features development or open source software porting/development for AIX OS
   

  

**Performance Engineer:**
 As a performance Engineer , you will get an opportunity to conduct experiments and analysis to identify performance aspects for operating systems and Enterprise Servers. where you will be responsible for advancing the product roadmap by using your expertise in Linux operating system, building kernel , applying patches, performance characterization, optimization and hardware architecture to analyse performance of software/hardware combinations. You will be involved in conducting experiments and analysis to identify performance challenges and uncover optimization opportunities for IBM Power virtualization and cloud management software built on Open stack. The areas of work will be on characterization, analysis and fine\-tune application software to help deliver optimal performance on IBM Power.
   

  

**Firmware Engineer:**
 As a Firmware developer you will be responsible for designing and developing components and features independently in IBM India Systems Development Lab. ISDL works on end\-to\-end design, development across Power, Z and Storage portfolio. You would be a part of WW Firmware development organization and would be involved in designing \& developing cutting edge features on the open source OpenBMC stack (\[1] \[1] \[1] \[1] \[1] \[1] https://github.com/openbmc/) and developing the open source embedded firmware code for bringing up the next generation enterprise Power, Z and LinuxONE Servers. You will get an opportunity work alongside with some of the best minds in the industry, forum and communities in the process of contributing to the portfolio.

 The Enterprise Systems Design team is keen on hiring passionate Computer science and engineering graduates / Masters students, who can blend their architectural knowledge and programming skills to build the complex infrastructure geared to work for the Hybrid cloud and AI workloads. We have several opportunities in following areas of System \& chip development team :

Will be responsible to creatively think of all the scenarios to test and report the coverage. Work with design as well as other key stakeholders in identifying /debugging \& Resolving logic design issues and deliver a quality design

title: Full-Stack Engineer — Systems Conductor
description:
About Bold Business
 





 Bold Business is an AI\-first, delivery\-first company building production\-grade enterprise software, automation engines, and autonomous agent infrastructure. We build the way modern teams build: our engineers are not syntax\-typists but Systems Conductors, who leverage advanced AI\-agent developer environments to design, build, test, and ship production software at multiples of traditional manual velocity.
 




  






 The Role
 





 We're hiring
 
****Full\-Stack Systems Conductors****

 to own feature delivery across our flagship TechForce platform — spanning React/TypeScript frontends, Python/FastAPI backends, and robust PostgreSQL data schemas.
 




  






 You'll own high\-impact modules from day one, but your true value lies in your ability to design robust databases, orchestrate complex systems, and lead background coding agents through rigorous, test\-driven implementations.
 




  





****Two principles define how we work, and we hire for both explicitly:****




  





****AI\-Agentic Command.****

 AI coding environments (Cursor, Claude Code CLI, OpenClaw / Hermes Agents / Grokbot / other personal agent harnesses, and custom Model Context Protocol servers) are our native workspace, not a novelty. We expect you to command agents to write boilerplate, scaffold routes, and draft test suites. You provide the system architecture, the security guardrails, and the rigorous critical review. Speed from agents, judgment from you.
 




  





****Collaborative by Default.****

 Every change is strictly peer\-reviewed through pull requests. Documentation and automated unit tests ship in the same PR as the code. Blockers get raised early, not discovered at review. We value highly legible, standardized architectures that outlive their author's immediate attention — brilliant work that only its author understands is a liability here, not an asset.
 




  






 What You'll Do
 



* ****Architect schema\-first features:****

 design strict API boundaries, typed contracts, and database schemas first, providing the structure background AI agents need to implement features safely
* ****Build and secure module workflows:****

 own recruiter and admin interfaces (screens, tables, profiles, forms, filters, dashboards), REST endpoints, and PostgreSQL relational workflows — with business security and authorization policies strictly enforced at the data layer
* ****Establish codebase context:****

 build and use MCP servers and AST\-based dependency graphs to give developer agents standardized, structured access to our repositories
* ****Orchestrate quality loops:****

 set up local testing environments and containerized CI/CD checks where background agents automatically execute test runs, linting, and type validation before any merge
* ****Engage directly with stakeholders:****

 sit with non\-technical stakeholders to translate messy operational processes into clean, executable technical requirements — and keep them in the loop as the work progresses
* ****Stabilize and maintain the platform:****

 production defects, small\-to\-medium gaps, and reporting migration support as Power BI is retired
* ****Review and be reviewed:****

 give and receive pull\-request review as a normal working rhythm, with test evidence on every ticket



  






 Non\-Negotiables
 





 We'll ask you to demonstrate all of the following — come ready with real examples:
 




  




1. ****Active agentic developer loop.****

 You've transitioned beyond copy\-pasting code blocks from a browser window. You can walk us through your CLI\-native agentic loop: how you coordinate agents, what parameters and guardrails you set, and — specifically — a time you caught and patched an LLM hallucination before it shipped. "I've tried Copilot" is not this.
2. ****Collaboration you can prove.****

 A working history of PR reviews given and received, documentation you wrote that someone else actually used, and a time you escalated a blocker early instead of grinding on it alone. We will check for this specifically.
3. ****Full\-stack competency, production\-grade.****

 Strong React/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI experience on real systems in real use — not tutorials or side scripts.
4. ****Database schema and security mastery.****

 Highly fluent in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, transactional isolation. You understand why hiding a button in React is not an authorization control; authorization is enforced in the data layer.
5. ****Clean systems architecture.****

 You build robust, decoupled state machines (FastAPI, React state, background queues) that gracefully isolate, log, and recover from real\-world API and network failures.
6. ****Enterprise systems awareness.****

 You've designed, maintained, or operated within ERP\-class platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or comparable) — or can clearly demonstrate how they work and why they matter: integrated data, standardized process, and a single operational source of truth. You'll help build a platform that plays exactly this role, so you need to understand what it replaces and what it must not break.
7. ****True Agile and continuous improvement.****

 Not standup theater — iterative delivery, working software shipped in small increments, retrospectives that actually change how the team works. Come ready to describe a real process improvement you drove based on what a sprint or a failure taught you.
8. ****End\-to\-end micro\-project ownership.****

 You'll run micro\-projects through their full lifecycle: planning and requirements gathering with stakeholders, implementation, testing, and maintenance afterward — documenting your work and processes clearly enough that another team member can be trained to support and back up what you built without you in the room. Come ready to walk us through one project you carried from first conversation to steady\-state maintenance.
9. ****Strong English communication, written and spoken.****

 You'll operate in a U.S.\-based team environment and explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders.



  






 Nice to Have
 



* Hands\-on experience with OpenClaw, Hermes Agents, or Grokbot agent platforms
* Familiarity with LangGraph or stateful multi\-agent orchestration
* Operations\-heavy SaaS experience (recruiting, workforce management, ATS, or CRM)
* Multi\-tenant application experience
* AWS exposure (EC2, RDS, S3, cloud logs)
* Data imports, deduplication, search/filter interfaces, operational reporting
* Experience joining a codebase mid\-flight and getting productive fast



  






 What This Role Is
 



* A hands\-on builder\-conductor role with defined module ownership
* AI\-accelerated delivery with human judgment on every merge
* A high\-performing team operating model: review, documentation, and early communication are the job, not overhead



  






 What This Role Is Not
 



* Not a solo\-operator role — if your best work happens when nobody sees it until it's done, this will be a bad fit
* Not an ML research role
* Not a role where AI tools are optional



  






 Compensation \& Logistics
 




****Compensation based on experience.****

 Standard options package per company policy.
 




****Target start:****

 Immediately
 




  






 Final Note
 





 We will go deep into your past work — what you built, why you built it that way, what broke, and who else could run it after you. The engineers who thrive here are the ones whose systems outlive their attention: documented, reviewed, and understood by the team.
 




  





****Bold Business — AI\-First. Delivery\-First. Team\-First.****

 High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.

 Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.

 Experience developing health scores, early\-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.

 Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

 Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
   

  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators


 Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk\-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure\-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA\-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source\-to\-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation\-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high\-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit\-for\-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source\-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off\-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA\-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source\-to\-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source\-to\-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom\-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
* Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source\-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.
* Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit\-for\-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.
* Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.
* Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future\-state capital insights.
* Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.
* Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.
* Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.
* Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.
* Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source\-to\-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.
* Ability to understand exposure\-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off\-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA\-CCR, and operational risk.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive\-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.
* Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.
* Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.
* Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source\-to\-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.
* Familiarity with SA\-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.
* Certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, DAMA, or other relevant risk, data, or project delivery credentials.

description:

 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organization Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day\-to\-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.

Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**

The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform using Java, Spring boot and Node.js, and will leverage working knowledge of platforms such as PCF and AWS. The individual will set engineering standards, perform code reviews, mentor developers, and partner with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.

* Coordinate effectively with geographically distributed teams and ensure consistent implementation of shared standards and processes.

* 4\+ years of expertise in Java, Spring boot, Node JS and React JS, with proven ability to lead design and implementation for complex web applications.
* Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event\-driven systems), and building mission\-critical services with high availability and performance.
* Experience with Micro\-Frontends (preferred) and front\-end architecture, including shared components, governance, and build/deploy strategies.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud\-native practices (preferred), including security, scalability, and cost\-aware design.
* Familiarity with Apigee or a similar API management platform is preferred but not required.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
* AI\-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
